cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've set your place at home tonight. I finally learned your mother's dumplings; the networking dinner can proceed without you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your promotion campaign may resume tomorrow. Tonight I want you choosing us, not collecting a hot plate between appointments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll freeze them. We can eat together tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That postponement isn't approved. You used it on our anniversary. Call the dinner organizer and say you already have a commitment with me.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 assigns home dinner, A3 defers promotion efforts and A5 refuses meal postponement while directing cancellation, imposing A priority to demand the relationship be chosen.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 career opportunity causes A3 explicit relationship-over-appointments demand; B4 freezer solution causes A5 comparison with a previous postponement.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a substantial professional chance and B4 offers a practical compromise, giving A a meaningful competing choice.

heightening.evidence: B4 tomorrow solution recalls the anniversary deferral, causing A5 insistence this dinner count as a commitment now.

specificity.evidence: A1 learned family dumplings and B2 director attendance define both stakes; A5 anniversary is a stated relevant precedent.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 postponement not approved makes household commitment sound formally binding, with restrained wit and real emotional pressure.
